head: 8d95170b5babd0aa3552f4b087528b6ab6987fa8
title: ci: bind package integration to Platform 1.1.7
body:
Align required package integration with genuine Platform v1.1.7 (`ed1560a57f4d4cb55b6b03f485cbfa01316837a7`) and published Builds/tool 4.43.6 (`725754075e1d6369430a3adf94d46fb71e6eaf9e`). Update the stale v2 workflow and exact owner assertions while retaining all 20 whole isolated projects, explicit reader-only secrets and independent owner gates. Existing coherent tool/gitlink pins stay intact.

After the real gateway/Redis end-state assertions pass, bounded diagnostics measure SDK assemblies already loaded in that native test process. Identity and surviving output use only the published G4 handoff: descriptor, plan, issued owner state and cryptographically verified source mapping. The actual owner context and caller Git revision are cross-checked; the existing caller invocation must match the context and selected profile before private CreateNew JSON is retained under its classified artifact directory. The production child environment remains scrubbed. No artificial assembly loading, functional-observation schema change or production API change is introduced.

Validation: supported signed 4.43.6 package preparation and Release/package fixture build passed; 3 caller-contract controls passed. In an actual process limited to the published inherited allowlist plus seven real mapping keys, 7 local handoff/file controls passed with zero GitHub identity injection or skips. They prove actual mapping serialization/hash, caller-directory survival and run/attempt/mapping/context/overwrite/link refusals; they supply no hosted owner or native credit. Earlier missing-descriptor HXT106 failures and all first receipts remain retained. Incoming Admin and Azure changes through main `d836aaf2f2ad299f398c8f8d1b7ff6ec47604cf8` were merged normally and preserved.

Full hosted isolated/native execution, measured official SDK comparison and receipt-bound cleanup remain pending. Require both named real gateway tests to pass; local I/O/metadata controls cannot substitute. No candidate acceptance.
